gt_provenance.details: Historical user text is real, but next-action ground truth labels are rule-derived proxy labels, not human or official benchmark labels.

score_normalization.details: Accuracy and macro-F1 are computed from raw counts; no self-normalized score was found.

result_existence.details: Main fixed-split and robustness claims are backed by existing metrics files.

dead_code.details: Main metric functions are called; some diagnostic/reporting scripts are not part of the current claim path.

scope.details: Single-user, 257-example proxy replay benchmark with 5 random episode and 5 random conversation robustness splits.

manual_label_audit.details: Manual spot audit of 12 high-risk candidates found 6 clear label errors, 1 borderline case, and 5 acceptable labels. The dominant noise mode is topic_shift overuse on same-thread refinements.

claims.claim: Learned state routing improves replay next-action prediction over no-state and heuristic baselines.
Dynamic state is more useful than current static persona/refinement mechanisms.
The system is a complete personal digital twin.
